links.comparator_used: Standard ChatGPT responses with no reading-level instruction
links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid grade level) versus accuracy and appropriateness of responses, rated by five orthopaedic surgeons
links.effect: Sixth-grade responses scored lower on accuracy (3.6 ± 0.76 vs. 4.7 ± 0.47; P < 0.001) and appropriateness (3.7 ± 0.98 vs. 4.5 ± 0.57; P < 0.001). Standard responses had a higher Flesch-Kincaid grade level than sixth-grade responses (P < 0.001), so the sixth-grade prompt was easier to read. No grade-level values were given.
links.tradeoff: The sixth-grade prompt improved readability but lowered accuracy and appropriateness. Sixth-grade responses were also rated worse than OrthoInfo on both measures (P < 0.001).
links.quote: Despite being easier to read, sixth-grade level ChatGPT responses compromised on accuracy and appropriateness.

design_hint: reading-level constraint on LLM patient education responses
